title: Madeleine et Georges de Scudéry: Artamène ou le Grand Cyrus
institution: Université de Fribourg (Claude Bourqui, Alexandre Gefen and Barbara Selmeci; original site 2002-2019, Université de Neuchâtel)
author: Madeleine and Georges de Scudéry
notes: Complete text of the novel in diplomatic reproduction (edition of Paris, Courbé, 1656), divided into sequences and episodes with summaries, pop-up notes on characters and places, and the engravings of the 1654 edition. Each of the ten parts can be downloaded as a PDF (https://artamene.othone.org/pdfs/cyrus1.pdf to cyrus10.pdf); the site also gives a full-text search through the ARTFL PhiloLogic server and says TEI files are on the project's GitHub, but no repository could be found. Counts are ours: about 2,010,000 words in the ten PDFs (summaries included, so slightly high), 10 parts. The PDFs were last modified on 6 March 2024.
